messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-canary, symptom=p99-generation-5xx-spike. Trigger: deploy/2026-03-14-canary v2 -> 40% traffic.

pd-bot: PagerDuty triggered: INC-8675309. Escalation level: primary -> on-call eng-oncall.

Maya: acked INC-8675309. jumping on it now — pulling logs and canary metrics.

Jordan: grabbing the canary dashboards. I see a sharp p95/p99 jump and a rise in 502/504 from transformer-hosts-12..15. Correlates with canary rollout at 00:12 UTC.

Lina: adding query: is this only generation endpoints or embed endpoints too?

Maya: generation-only so far (text-gen). embed service looks normal. attaching short logs: ```
[03:14:02] host=transformer-host-13 module=inference error="kv-cache mismatch"
[03:14:03] host=transformer-host-14 module=runtime code=SIGPIPE
[03:14:04] host=transformer-host-12 module=network error=timeout
```

Jordan: hmm kv-cache mismatch + SIGPIPE suggests a quantized kernel path regression. New build enabled fast-kv-concat in v2. Rolling fallback available: v2-fallback (no fast-kv). ops-deploy, can you hold new canary traffic and re-route?

ops-deploy: pausing staged rollout now. routing rule updated to divert new canary traffic back to stable pool. applied in 3s. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Canary traffic diversion executed. Canary percentage -> 0%. Metrics: p99 beginning to trend down.

Maya: confirming reduced errors in last 30s on hosts 12-15. still seeing a handful of 502s but trending.

pd-bot: INC-8675309 moved to acknowledged -> investigating. Escalation timer paused.

Avi (CS): any customer impact? we have one enterprise customer running live inference on that canary cohort. Need to let them know if rollback required.

Maya: initial check: error surface affected ~0.6% of requests, mostly short-lived failures; however one workspace reported repeated retries. I'm drafting a short customer note.

Jordan: suggestion: revert the fast-kv-concat change in the build and promote v2-fallback as new canary, then run a controlled rollout after 1 hour of steady metrics. If urgent, rollback the entire release to v1 baseline. Which do we prefer?

Lina: prefer targeted rollback of the change (promote v2-fallback). That avoids full rollback and preserves other fixes. ops-deploy can you promote and pin traffic?

ops-deploy: promoting v2-fallback into canary slot and pinning traffic to stable for now. command: `deploy promote canary v2-fallback --pin --verify 60s` — started.

incident-bot: Deploy promote job started (job=promote-4523456789-1). Watch logs at https://ci.redwood/deploys/promote-4523456789-1

Maya: monitoring logs — hosts 12/13 switching to v2-fallback. No new 5xx during promotion so far.

Jordan: metrics show p99 back within baseline after host switch. good sign.

Avi (CS): Sent a short proactive note to affected workspace: "We've detected elevated generation errors due to a canary change and have diverted traffic. No action required; we'll follow up with timeline." They replied: "thanks, appreciate the quick handling".

Maya: once promote job completes, plan: keep canary traffic 0% for 30m, run canary-smoke test, then resume staged rollout at 5% with health gates. We'll keep incident open until 60m steady.

pd-bot: INC-8675309 status: monitoring. If stability holds for 60m, we'll resolve the incident and file follow-up ticket for postmortem.

Jordan: follow-ups: create postmortem ticket linking deploy id, kernel change diff, and canary metrics. also add automated test for kv-cache edge cases in CI.

Maya: assigned immediate action items. closing communication loop in 10m unless regression. nice work team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Note: automated page suppression will remain while incident is acknowledged. Remember to escalate manually if new errors spike.

Lina: quick note — log snippet for postmortem saved to /var/logs/incidents/4523456789-kvcache.log and uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/4523456789/kvcache.log

Maya: resolving my on-call tasks here, handing to Jordan for postmortem follow-up. Jordan, take the ticket?

Jordan: taking it. I'll create PM and loop in infra and runtime-team for patch review.

Maya: thanks — I'll update the incident thread if anything else pops up.

pd-bot: INC-8675309 will auto-resolve if no further alerts in 60m.

end of thread: summary pinned by Maya: "Canary deploy triggered 5xx spike tied to fast-kv-concat kernel path. Diverted traffic, promoted v2-fallback to canary, pinned stable traffic. Monitoring; follow-up postmortem scheduled."
